claims.identity: Dutch full-time ordinary Leiden BA Chinese Studies, registry recognised code56818, 180EC target, no formal specialisation. OER2.2/2.9 and current BA-CHI identity confirm.
claims.allocation: Current annual 2026–2027 BA-CHI framework: year 1 55 compulsory + 5 bounded choice = 60 EC; year 2 25 compulsory + 15 content choices + 5 shared Asian-studies teaching + 15 Mandarin 2c = 60 EC. Ordinary Mandarin 2c abroad is one 15-EC component, not an extra overseas block; the Leiden shadow programme is conditional. No formal specialisations. Political economy and society choices are retained independently of UCR fit: Modern Chinese Economy and Development, Chinese Politics in the Era of AI, Sociology and Anthropology of Modern China and Japan in the 21st Century. In year 3, Mandarin 3a/3b total 10; one ordinary content seminar is 5; the other content seminar and BA Paper together are 10, not 5+10 (5683VBAWSY assessment). Genuine open space is 30. This independently supported subset totals 175 EC. The language-choice group is numerically 5 EC and one choice, but its semester instructions demand two 5-EC choices. Including one would close 180, including both would give 185 after correctly integrating the thesis. Neither interpretation is certified here. The previously stored 190-EC diagnostic double-counted the thesis-linked seminar. The formal OER Article 4.2 governs language and content prerequisites and propedeuse before thesis/overseas participation; Appendix F only replaces first-year units. It does not correct the language-choice conflict. Mentoring is a separately noted zero-credit activity. The public chart illustrates one language choice and integrated thesis, but retains replaced first-year titles and cannot establish precedence over the contradictory current guide.

thesisResolution.finding: Regular seminar assessment earns5; choosing the BA Paper instead earns10 for seminar and paper together. The old diagnostic counted its5 twice. Keep Labor Migration5 and integrated Global Political Economy/paper10. No need for another source for this resolved question.
